title: [finding] `TimelineConfigSchema` declares seven members and `ObjectTimeline` reads an eighth off the same block — `timeline.metaFields` is consumed by the renderer and refused by the schema
body:
⏱️ Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 2 (session `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`) at 2026-09-21T11:31Z. ⛔ Filed bare — no `priority:*`, no `domain:*`, no type, no assignee. Routing and grading are triage's.

## The fact

`TimelineConfigSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`) is a `strictObject` declaring exactly seven members: `startDateField`, `endDateField`, `titleField`, `groupByField`, `colorField`, `scale`, `limit`.

objectui's `ObjectTimeline` reads an **eighth** member off that same nested block — `metaFields` — and its own comment at `ObjectTimeline.tsx:516` calls the source 「Spec config: `timeline.metaFields`」. The read is at `:520-521`, through an `as any` cast on the receiver.

An author who writes it is refused: `metaFields` on a `timeline` block parses to `unrecognized_keys` under path `timeline`. No alias is declared for it, and nothing under `packages/spec/src/conversions` names it.

⇒ A key the renderer is written to consume cannot be authored, and the refusal names no replacement.

## ⛔ What this card is NOT about

⛔ **`dateField` is deliberately excluded.** It is read at `ObjectTimeline.tsx:475` off the same block and is also refused — but that refusal is a **standing ruling**, not a gap: `packages/spec/src/shared/polarity-axes.ts:35` carries the #18572 stop condition, 「No alias is declared: `dateField` does not acquire a meaning here, it acquires an honest answer.」 Bundling the two would reopen a settled decision. This card is `metaFields` alone.

⛔ It is also **not** the per-kind `limit` precedence question, which is the open half of #19228 and stays there.

## Provenance, and what this seat did and did not measure

Both readings above were taken by **isolated at-tier reviewers** (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`) against objectui at the pin `87af769e9a3ee28ace099fdd653d3ebd79fe82e2`, and recorded on card #19228:

- round 4 record, comment **5759348642** (③3) — 80 of the population parsed; the `descriptionField` correction established there too: it is read off the FLAT element-face key (`:478`) and IS declared, so it is not part of this.
- round 5 record, comment **5759714087** (③1) — re-confirmed unchanged at the following head.

⚠️ **This seat did not re-measure at the pin first-hand.** The claim is relayed from those two records, which are the reviews of record on their heads. Whoever takes this card should re-read at the CURRENT `.objectui-sha`, because a pin bump can move it — and note that the pin-citation gate's `--verify-anchors` covers only content-asserting citations, so these particular anchors are verified by no gate.

## Why it is worth a card rather than an acceptance note

The 「who will touch this file?」 test has an answer: the next card that changes `TimelineConfigSchema`, which is a live surface — two review rounds this week worked inside it. ⇒ ⛔ Not a bottom-of-PR note that nobody inherits.

The disposition is the ADR-0049 fork, and both arms are real: **declare** `metaFields` on the block (the renderer already consumes it), or **remove** the read in objectui. ⛔ This seat picks neither; the seam is cross-repo and the choice is a contract decision.

## Dedup words
